Refus.PasCadavre: This creature is not a corpse.
Refus.PasAToi: You do not own this character.
Refus.MJSeul: Only the GM can search corpses.
Refus.Loin: Too far away: step closer to search.

Notice.NoGM: No GM connected: searching needs an active GM.

Chat.Caught: {thief} tried to rob {victim} and was caught (Sleight of Hand {total} vs DC {dc}).

Reach.Name: Search reach
Reach.Hint: How close a character must be to a corpse to search it, in feet (edge to edge). Converted on metric scenes: 5 ft = 1.5 m.

WhoLoots.Name: Who can search corpses
WhoLoots.Hint: Players themselves, or the GM only.

Announce.Name: Announce what is taken
Announce.Hint: A chat message listing what was taken from a corpse.

AutoTreasure.Name: Roll treasure on corpses
AutoTreasure.Hint: The first time a corpse is searched, roll its individual treasure by CR (DMG 2024): coins, or gemstones (Arcana) and art objects (Relics) when the Dungeon Master's Guide module is active. Creatures without a treasure preference have none.

Pockets.Name: Humanoid pockets
Pockets.Hint: Humanoids may also carry a few mundane items (rations, candles, a torch, a trinket…) from the Player's Handbook.

TheftHostile.Name: Caught thieves make enemies
TheftHostile.Hint: When a pickpocket fails, the victim's token turns hostile. Otherwise it only becomes wary and the GM is told.

DropMode.Name: Drop items on the ground
DropMode.Hint: Drag an item from a character sheet onto the map to drop it there (a half-square pile, picked up like a container).

DeleteStores.Name: Delete the store with its container
DeleteStores.Hint: Deleting a container or a pile from the scene (its region or its tile) also deletes the actor created for it in the containers folder. Off: the actor stays, to be removed by hand.

ThrownWeapons.Name: Thrown weapons leave the hand
ThrownWeapons.Hint: A weapon thrown with the combat engine leaves the thrower: on a hit it stays lodged in the target half the time (in its inventory, recoverable when it dies), otherwise it drops at the target's feet; on a miss it lands 1–3 squares beyond, stopped by walls.

SearchRadius.Name: Search radius
SearchRadius.Hint: Distance in feet covered by "Search the surroundings", stopped by walls (converted on metric scenes: 5 ft = 1.5 m). A hidden object may require the searcher to be closer.

SearchMenu.Name: Offer "Search the surroundings"
SearchMenu.Hint: Adds the "Search the surroundings" action to the context menu of one’s own token. Unchecked: the action leaves the menu, but hidden objects are still found by passive Perception. Mostly useful for dungeon crawls.

SearchCooldown.Name: Delay between searches
SearchCooldown.Hint: Out of combat, minutes (of world time or real time, whichever passes first) before the same character can "Search the surroundings" again (0: no delay). In combat, searching takes an action.

SearchDuration.Name: Search duration
SearchDuration.Hint: Out of combat, real seconds that "Search the surroundings" lasts: a progress bar for the player, a ping around the token; moving interrupts it (0: instant).

DisarmDuration.Name: Disarm duration
DisarmDuration.Hint: Real seconds that « Disarm the trap » takes before the roll: a progress bar for the player, a ping and a tool noise around the token; moving interrupts it (0: at once).

AdvancedTraps.Name: Advanced trap mode
AdvancedTraps.Hint: Out of combat, a trap that goes off pauses the game and starts a combat with the scene's creatures (player characters Surprised if nobody had spotted it); the trap acts at its own initiative (20 by default). In combat, initiative isn't rerolled. Either way, no automatic roll: the GM gives each creature in the area Advantage or Disadvantage, then launches the trap. Off: the trap strikes at once.

Lock.NoWay: You have neither the key nor thieves' tools.

label.label: Name
label.hint: Shown in the search window title. Empty: the region name.

actor.label: Contents
actor.hint: The Group actor holding the contents, created automatically. Open its sheet to drop items and coins in.

table.label: Roll table
table.hint: Rolled once, the first time the container is opened. Linked items, @UUID item links in the text, or plain text (becomes a loot item).

draws.label: Draws
draws.hint: How many times the table is rolled.

hoard.label: Treasure hoard
hoard.hint: Random Treasure Hoard (DMG 2024) of that CR band: coins and magic items, rolled once at first opening.

theme.label: Treasure theme
theme.hint: Arcana: gemstones; Relics: art objects; magic items from that theme's tables (Any: 1d4 per item).

rolled.label: Already rolled
rolled.hint: Untick to roll the table and hoard again at the next opening (adds to the contents).

locked.label: Locked
locked.hint: Opened with the key, thieves' tools (Dexterity check) or by the GM.

dc.label: Lock DC
dc.hint: DC of the thieves' tools check to pick the lock.

key.label: Key
key.hint: Name of the item that opens the lock (case ignored).

owner.label: Owner
owner.hint: Whoever owns the contents. If set, whatever is taken is flagged as stolen from them.

Tables.MenuHint: Creates in this world the generic loot tables (chest, barrel, crate, bookshelf, desk, altar, camp bag) from Player's Handbook items, in the “Loot — tables” folder. Tables already created are left as they are.
Tables.NeedPHB: The Player's Handbook module must be active.

Steal.Title: Pickpocket: {name}
Steal.Hint: One try per item. A failure is noticed.

Necro.DialogCaster: Under the control of {name} (the selected token).
Necro.DialogNoCaster: No caster selected: the undead will belong to no player.
Necro.Name: {undead} ({name})
Necro.NotRaisable: Only the corpse of a Small or Medium humanoid can be raised.
Necro.NeedMM: The Monster Manual module must be active.

Drop.NotOnScene: Your character is not on this scene.
Drop.NotGear: {item}: a creature's attack, not an object — nothing is dropped

Trade.Title: Trade: {a} ⇄ {b}
Trade.DropHint: Drag items from your sheet here.
Trade.NotYours: Only items of your own character can be offered.
Trade.Impossible: You can only trade with another player character.
Trade.WindowFailed: The trade window could not open: {reason}

Shop.Title: Shop: {name}
Shop.Hint: Click an item to put one on the tray (Shift: the whole stack). Click it on the tray to take it back.
Shop.GMHint: Right-click an item to cycle it: on display but not for sale → hidden → for sale.
Shop.TooFar: Too far: get closer to the merchant.
Shop.MerchantNoFunds: The merchant doesn't have enough money: take something else in exchange.
Shop.Refused: The merchant refuses this stolen item.
Shop.Fenced: Stolen item: bought at a discount.
Shop.Changed: The stock or your inventory changed: check the trade.

Merchant.Title: Merchant: {name}
Merchant.EnabledHint: Players open the shop by clicking its token, out of combat.
Merchant.OwnerHint: The shop refuses anything stolen from this name.
Merchant.BuyHint: What the player pays: item price × this factor.
Merchant.SellHint: What the merchant gives: item price × this factor (0.5: half price).
Merchant.AttitudeHint: Friendly: 10% in the player's favor. Hostile: 20% against them.

StolenPolicy.own: Refuses what was stolen from them

Merchant.FenceRateHint: Share of the selling price given for a stolen item.
Merchant.TablesHint: Tables drawn at each restock (what had been drawn goes first).
Merchant.MemorizeHint: Restocking will bring the fixed stock and the till back to their present state.
Merchant.TypesHint: Multiplied by the merchant's factors (1: no effect).
Merchant.CharactersHint: Attitude toward them, and a discount in % (positive: in their favor).
Merchant.ItemPiles: This actor is an Item Piles merchant.

label.label: Name
label.hint: Zone name. Empty: the target document's name, else the region's.

reach.label: Require reach
reach.hint: The character must be within reach ("Search reach" setting); out of reach, they walk there first. Uncheck for a zone usable from afar.

Zone.NoScene: This zone leads to no scene.
Zone.NoDocument: This zone opens no journal or page.
Zone.NoPermission: You may not read this document.
Zone.GrantFailed: The document could not be shared with you.

MacroZone.Hint: Clicking the region runs a macro for whoever clicks, even without permission on it.

macro.label: Macro
macro.hint: Runs for the clicking player, with their rights. Arguments: speaker, actor, token, character, scope (behavior, region, looter).

SceneZone.Hint: Clicking the region shows another scene to whoever clicks.

targetScene.label: Scene
targetScene.hint: The scene shown to whoever clicks.

activateForAll.label: Activate for everyone (GM)
activateForAll.hint: When the GM clicks, the scene is activated for the whole table instead of only viewed.

DocumentZone.Hint: Clicking the region opens a journal or a page.

document.label: Journal or page
document.hint: UUID of a journal or one of its pages.

grant.label: Grant read permission
grant.hint: If the player cannot read the document, the connected GM grants them Observer (permanent).

TileZone.HudTooltip: Create a DAS zone shaped like this tile
TileZone.Title: Tile → DAS zone
TileZone.Name: Name
TileZone.Hint: The region follows the image's visible outline (its rectangle if the image cannot be read). The other settings open next.
TileZone.NotOnCanvas: This tile is not on the viewed scene.
TileZone.Traced: Zone "{name}" ({type}) created from the image outline.
TileZone.Rectangle: Zone "{name}" ({type}) created on the tile rectangle: the image cannot be read.

enabled.label: Hidden
enabled.hint: Invisible and unusable for players until a character finds it (passive Perception when passing by, or "Search the surroundings"). Its tiles are hidden and its core behaviors disabled until then.

skill.label: Skill
skill.hint: The skill that finds it: Perception (Search action) or Investigation (Study action).

dc.label: Detection DC
dc.hint: Passive score or search roll to reach.

passive.label: Passive distance
passive.hint: In feet (converted on metric scenes: 5 ft = 1.5 m): a character who comes within this distance, in line of sight, finds it if their passive score reaches the DC. 0: no passive detection.

radius.label: Search radius
radius.hint: Maximum distance of an active search, in feet (the world setting, or less: a needle is only seen within 5 ft).

found.label: Found
found.hint: Uncheck to hide it again: tiles and behaviors go back to hidden, attempts are cleared.

text.label: Discovery text
text.hint: What the finding player reads. Empty: a generic text ("You notice a hidden cache.").

Found.TrapSource: You notice where a trap strikes from.

Wall.Hint: Secret door or ethereal wall: found by passive Perception or by "Search the surroundings", it becomes a regular door or stops blocking sight.

Hidden.Cooldown: {name} has just searched: wait {minutes} more minute(s) of game time before searching again.

Budget.noAction: {name} has no action left this turn

TrapZone.Hint: Put it on the trap's effect area (the corridor the fire sweeps, or the plate itself): it holds the whole trap. A token entering its trigger (this region, or another one picked on the map) sets it off: the trap actor uses its activity on the tokens in the effect area (resolved by the combat engine). Trigger and source are each found on their own; a spotted trigger shows in red and the combat engine's pathfinding avoids it, a spotted source shows in red with the effect area in orange; either can be disarmed with a click (thieves' tools).

actor.label: Trap actor
actor.hint: The actor that "casts" the trap (a trap from the DMG 2024, or a homemade NPC), with no token on the map.

activity.label: Activity
activity.hint: Id of the activity used. Empty: the one whose level range ("Levels 5–10") contains the targets' level (highest character, else highest CR), otherwise the first.

triggerRegion.label: Trigger
triggerRegion.hint: The region a token must enter (the pressure plate), picked on the map. Empty: this region.

minSize.label: Minimum size
minSize.hint: The smallest creature that sets it off. Small by default: a rat or a Tiny familiar walks over it.

height.label: Height
height.hint: Above the area's floor (scene units), a token does not trigger: a flying creature passes. 0: only what touches the floor.

source.label: Source
source.hint: Where the effect comes from (the holes in the wall, the statue).

uuid.label: Source
uuid.hint: A region or a tile of the scene, picked on the map. Empty: the trigger itself. Once spotted, the effect area shows too.

enabled.label: Hidden
enabled.hint: The source can't be seen until a character finds it (passive Perception, or "Search the surroundings"). Its own DC: finding the source does not find the rest.

skill.label: Skill
skill.hint: The one that finds it: Perception or Investigation.

dc.label: Detection DC
dc.hint: Passive score or search roll to reach.

passive.label: Passive distance
passive.hint: In feet (converted on a scene in metres). 0: no passive detection.

radius.label: Search radius
radius.hint: Maximum distance of an active search, in feet.

found.label: Found
found.hint: Untick to hide it again; attempts are cleared.

text.label: Discovery text
text.hint: What the player who finds it reads. Empty: a generic text.

initiative.label: Initiative
initiative.hint: Its place in the initiative in advanced trap mode: 20 by default, lower for a slow trap (a descending ceiling).

armed.label: Armed
armed.hint: Check again to re-arm the trap manually.

delay.label: Re-arm delay
delay.hint: In minutes of world time (calendar), for "After a delay".

triggeredAt.label: Triggered at
triggeredAt.hint: World time of the last trigger (filled automatically).

effectRegion.label: Effect area (0.16.0)
effectRegion.hint: Left by version 0.16.0, when the trap sat on its plate: read once to move the trap onto this area.

hidden.label: Hidden trigger
hidden.hint: How the trigger (the plate) is found. The source has its own detection.

TrapZone.DisarmFireCard: {name} sets off {trap} while trying to disarm it!
TrapZone.ConfirmText: Try to disarm {trap}? {name} will make a thieves' tools check.

TrapRelay.Name: DAS · Trap trigger
TrapRelay.Hint: Added by DAS · Loot & Trade on the region picked as a trap's trigger: a token entering it sets off that trap. Nothing to set.

trap.label: Trap
trap.hint: The DAS · Trap behavior this region sets off.

TrapWindow.Title: Trap: {name}
TrapWindow.HintSave: The trap strikes. For each creature in its area, favour their saving throw (Advantage) or not (Disadvantage) according to how the players played it, or remove them; then launch it.
TrapWindow.HintAttack: The trap strikes. For each creature in its area, favour them (the trap's attack roll against them has Disadvantage) or not (Advantage) according to how the players played it, or remove them; then launch it.
TrapWindow.Nobody: Nobody is in the effect area any more.

ConvertItemPiles.NeedModule: DAS · Loot & Trade (darsh-loot) 0.13.0 or later is required (is the module active?).
ConvertItemPiles.Title: Import Item Piles merchants
ConvertItemPiles.Intro: “Report” changes nothing: it lists the merchants that would be imported.
ConvertItemPiles.NoneFound: Item Piles merchants: none in this world, nothing to do.
ConvertItemPiles.SummaryDry: Item Piles merchants — report, nothing was changed: {count} of {total} to import
ConvertItemPiles.NotifyDry: {count} merchant(s) to import — summary in the chat.
ConvertItemPiles.Notify: {count} merchant(s) imported — summary in the chat.

trap.label: Trapped container
trap.hint: A trap that goes off when the container is opened, or when picking its lock fails.

actor.label: Trap actor
actor.hint: The actor that "casts" the trap (a DMG 2024 trap, or a hand-made NPC), with no token on the map.

activity.label: Activity
activity.hint: Id of the activity used. Empty: the one whose level tier matches the targets, else the first.

effectRegion.label: Effect area
effectRegion.hint: UUID of a region of the scene, even elsewhere (the dart wall across the room, the corridor the gas fills). Empty: only whoever opens it.

trigger.label: Goes off
trigger.hint: On opening (the lid lifted, the lock giving way), on a failed lock pick, or both.

armed.label: Armed
armed.hint: Tick again to rearm the trap by hand.

delay.label: Rearm delay
delay.hint: In minutes of world time (calendar), for "after a delay".

triggeredAt.label: Triggered at
triggeredAt.hint: World time of the last trigger (filled in automatically).

enabled.label: Hidden
enabled.hint: The trap can't be seen until a character finds it (passive Perception, or "Search the surroundings"). Once found, the container glows red and opening it first asks: disarm, open anyway or give up.

skill.label: Skill
skill.hint: The one that finds it: Perception or Investigation.

dc.label: Detection DC
dc.hint: Passive score or search roll to reach.

passive.label: Passive distance
passive.hint: In feet (converted on a scene in metres). 0: no passive detection.

radius.label: Search radius
radius.hint: Maximum distance of an active search, in feet (a needle is only seen within 5 ft).

found.label: Found
found.hint: Untick to hide it again; attempts are cleared.

text.label: Discovery text
text.hint: What the player who finds it reads. Empty: "You notice a trap."

minSize.label: Minimum size
minSize.hint: The smallest creature whose opening sets it off. Small by default.

initiative.label: Initiative
initiative.hint: Its place in the initiative in advanced trap mode (20 by default).

source.label: Source
source.hint: Where the effect comes from, if not the container itself.

uuid.label: Source
uuid.hint: A region or a tile of the scene, picked on the map. Empty: the container itself.

enabled.label: Hidden
enabled.hint: The source can't be seen until a character finds it (passive Perception, or "Search the surroundings"). Its own DC: finding the source does not find the rest.

skill.label: Skill
skill.hint: The one that finds it: Perception or Investigation.

dc.label: Detection DC
dc.hint: Passive score or search roll to reach.

passive.label: Passive distance
passive.hint: In feet (converted on a scene in metres). 0: no passive detection.

radius.label: Search radius
radius.hint: Maximum distance of an active search, in feet.

found.label: Found
found.hint: Untick to hide it again; attempts are cleared.

text.label: Discovery text
text.hint: What the player who finds it reads. Empty: a generic text.

TrappedTrap.GateText: {name} is trapped. What do you do?

Door.Hint: For a door: a trap that goes off when it opens (click on the door or the engine's menu), and / or when picking its lock fails. Without an effect area, it only hits whoever opens it.
Door.Actor: Trap actor (UUID, or drop an actor)
Door.EffectRegion: Effect area (region UUID, empty: whoever opens it)
Door.MinSize: Minimum size (smallest creature that sets it off)
Door.Source: Source (region or tile UUID, empty: the door)

Token.Hint: This creature is a trap (a DMG 2024 trap, or any NPC you tick here). Its placed token is the trap: hidden from players, it goes off when a creature walks onto its squares (or onto the trigger picked below), on the creatures of its squares (or of the effect area picked below). Set on the prototype token, these settings are copied to every token placed; each placed token keeps its own state.
Token.TriggerRegion: Trigger (region UUID; empty: the token's squares)
Token.EffectRegion: Effect area (region UUID; empty: the token's squares)
Token.Source: Source (region or tile UUID; empty: the token when the trigger is elsewhere)
Token.SourceHidden: Hidden source (the token, when the trigger is elsewhere)

Pick.PromptRegion: Click a region on the map (right-click or Escape: cancel).
Pick.PromptTile: Click a region or a tile on the map (right-click or Escape: cancel).
